basic_profile.bio: RetroPixelWarrior is a 28-year-old software engineer based in Austin, Texas. A self-proclaimed tech enthusiast with a penchant for vintage Apple products, they spend their free time tinkering with old gadgets and exploring the intricacies of retro games. Outside the digital realm, they have a blue-tongue skink named Rex. They're single and usually online during evenings and weekends, often balancing their time between work and indulging in their passion for Skyrim mods and tabletop RPGs.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a computer science degree from a state university, RetroPixelWarrior has a solid foundation in programming and technology. Their love for vintage tech led them to self-learn about the intricacies of old Apple systems, and they frequently share tips and tricks in tech-savvy communities. They also have a growing interest in game development, thanks to their ongoing exploration of Skyrim modding.
